issue.title: [Test Gap] [Snappi] Test-case required to apply optimization profiles and batching-bulking values for route convergence test.

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the test gap

The existing BGP convergence testcase in Snappi just check route convergence for 1k routes.

Require testcase to apply optimization profile, and batching-bulking values to the DUT and check route convergence time.

### Affected Area

Following files will need to be added or modified in the folders to test the above.
tests/snappi_tests/bgp/
tests/snappi_tests/bgp/bgp_convergence_helper.py

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

Proposed testcase:
- for each combination of optimization parameter, batching-bulking values and traffic-type, the test should measure convergence time.
- reset the values and repeat the test above.

resolution.title: [snappi] BGP route convergence optimization and performance test-script.
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

This is new SNAPPI test for BGP route performance using various optimization parameters for single-DUT.

These are controlled via following knobs:
	- Optimization parameters to be configured in config_db.json.
		Optimization parameters are controlled via fine-tuning.yml file present in snappi_tests/bgp/files folder.
	- Batching(b) and bulking(k) values.
		These parameters are passed via bk-values.json file present in the same folder.
	- Type of routes - IPv4, IPv6 and IPv4v6 routes.
		Passed on to the test as parameterized variable.
	- Number of routes.

For each combination of profile, bk-value, type of route, and number of route; convergence time is computed using existing rib_in_convergence test.

Note - The IPv4+IPv6 route combination is skipped due to existing Snappi issue (#22717 )

@rawal01 , @deepak-singhal0408 @sdszhang for viz.

Summary:
Fixes #22728

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [X] New Test case
    - [X] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [ ] 202511

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The test-case is added to fine-tune knobs on SONIC to check for improvement in route convergence time for higher number of routes (250k routes).

#### How did you do it?
How did you do it?
	- Created a new test-script:
	- Optimization profiles are passed to the test using fine-tuning.yml file.
	- Batching and bulking parameters are passed to test using bk-value.json file. If not, present, there is default list present in the test.
	- Type of routes (IPv4, IPv6 and IPv4v6) are passed to the test.
	- Number of routes (set to 250k routes).

For each combination of profile, bk-value pair, type of route - test case does the following:
- Start applying profile in config and bk-values in SWSS container /usr/bin/orchagent.sh file.
- Reboots the DUT.
- Increase in the frr_bgp, top, zebra and free thresholds.
- Create the IXIA and DUT BGP-portchannel configuration.
- Withdraw all the routes.
- Start protocol and traffic.
- Start advertising routes.
- Check for convergence time.
- Reverts back the config_db, and SWSS container file.
- Displays the BEFORE and AFTER memory utilization of various process and dockers.
- Reboots the DUT.
- Repeat the test for different combination.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Tested on local master repo along with original rib_in_convergence test to ensure there is no regression.

#### Any platform specific information?
single-DUT platforms (topology == 'tgen')
